name: codelink
description: Connect Codex tasks to WeChat for task intake and completion notifications.

interface.shortDescription: Receive Codex tasks from WeChat and send task updates back.
interface.longDescription: CodeLink connects a standalone WeChat iLink daemon to Codex. Incoming WeChat messages create independent Codex tasks, while any Codex task can send progress or completion notifications through the CodeLink MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: 任务完成后通过微信通知我。
把当前任务总结发送到微信。
